Pranav Iyer | Chennai | pranav.iyer@example.com | github.com/pranav-java

EDUCATION
B.Tech Information Technology, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai, 2026 | CGPA 8.7/10

INTERNSHIPS
Java Developer Intern, Adyar Software Solutions Pvt Ltd, Chennai | Jan 2026 - Apr 2026 (12 weeks)
- Built REST endpoints in Spring Boot for a leave management module with validation and paging.
- Wrote Java service classes using collections and streams to calculate leave balances.
- Wrote MySQL queries and added an index that cut the leave report query from 3s to 300ms.
- Raised pull requests in Git and fixed comments from code review.

Software Intern, Velachery Tech Labs, Remote | June 2025 - July 2025 (6 weeks)
- Fixed bugs in a JSP-based internal tool and wrote test cases in a spreadsheet.

PROJECTS
- Library Management System: Spring Boot and MySQL app with role-based login, designed with classes for books, members and loans following the repository pattern.
- Online Quiz App: Java Swing desktop app for the OOP course.

COURSEWORK AND CERTIFICATIONS
- Implemented AVL trees, heaps and graph algorithms in Java as part of the Data Structures course.
- Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer, 2025
- Coursework: DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Software Engineering

SKILLS
Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, MySQL, REST APIs, Git, JUnit, Redis (basics), HTML, CSS

ACTIVITIES
- 4-star on CodeChef; coordinator, college coding club.
